query: UPDATE core.plugin_downloads SET ready_version = building_version, ready_title = building_title, ready_permission = building_permission, ready_rows = building_rows, ready_bytes = building_bytes, built_at = now(), building_version = NULL, building_title = NULL, building_permission = NULL, building_columns = 0, building_rows = 0, building_bytes = 0 WHERE plugin_id = $1 AND name = $2
